[100m  [97m'label or f"mailbox-consume:{inbox}"' — the default names the INBOX, not the [39m
  [97mconsumer, so on the surface agents actually use, the actor field says 'the [39m
  [97mconsumer of mailbox X is mailbox-consume:X'. Anonymous by default, [39m
  [97midentifiable only for callers who opted in, and ftruncated on release so it [39m
  [97mis readable only while the drain is still running. Three properties, all [39m
  [97minverted from what provenance needs. THE ASK IS THE SWEEP PLUS A GUARD: [39m
  [97mforward the full signature in both handlers, and add whatever structural [39m
  [97mcheck keeps the adapter from silently narrowing mailbox.py again (a [39m
  [97msignature-parity test is the obvious shape — this is the THIRD instance of [39m
  [97mthe same drop in one file, so a one-off fix will not hold)..[39m
